question: By what means does the jīva enter the inner depth of that lotus?
premises: The destination is the depth of that lotus
Movement is accomplished by a bird
The jīva and Pārvatī are addressed
inference: The jīva enters the depth of that lotus by means of the bird.
uncertainties: The symbolic identity of the bird is not specified here.
plain_english: O jīva, O Pārvatī, having gone into the depth of that lotus by means of the bird.
